details:
Hello developers. This is very important feature request.
In last months, i noticed the scammers and new people are using the friend request system in bad way.

Every day i got like 4-10 requests popped up in VRChat or on VRChat website. I noticed most names have at end 4 numbers/letters combination. That is common for Steam name. And because nobody met me earlier in VRChat, i am sure most of them are players who want make friends quickly so they can attack them or steal avatars.
This is why i don't trust them.

But! Every day friend request popup. I am sure famous VRChat streamers will see it even more every day.
The system must changed soon as possible, because it's way too easy to send a request on VRChat site.
It's kinda bad security too. Fresh new players should _not_ allowed to send already friend requests on website (or ingame) because that is too fast and nobody want it.

So the changes in system are needed:
- New players may not use website to send friend requests for a week at least.
- If the trust rank is still white or blue, they may also not use ingame search to send a friend request. Only direct view ingame is possible (so we can direct check and ask player why send a friend request). Even better: they should not be able to send request but can ask for friend add to high trust ranked players. That is better way. Actually new players should ask first or talk first, because sudden send request is very rude way in most eyes.
- Also how much active in VRChat should also counted up. If you're for like 100 hours in VRChat, it might enable the friend request feature. This is sort of cooldown time, so it's less interesting for scammers to wait for long time before they can send requests.
- Also there must some penalty by sending many requests at short time. This is exactly scammers do it every day by sending a lot request to random people. You should add counter to limit it like 10 times / week or so. Only if trust rank goes more up to like orange or purple color, then person can do more requests / week time.

From now, website is way too easy used by scammers to send a lot requests. This must change.

And we need settings to protect ourselves. Let us set the trust level to allow friend requests, or only allow if they are friend to other friend who is also friend to the person. Here we can put the line there so everyone below the line cannot send request and must meet us first (and ask for friend add). Not ingame request send, not website request send.
- Minimal trust rank to allow send request. If person trust level is too low, it will blocked automatically with message.
- Amount of request send. This prevent send too many requests.
- Option to only use direct click & request (MEANS ingame in front of me, so player click directly on me) because most people will not allow remote friend request send (with website and ingame search & send)
- Let us set the cooldown period before person may start to send request. (like 1 week - 1 month time)

Only this way, the unwanted friend requests will stopped and we're all happy. Famous streamers have less work to clean up all unwanted requests. It helps a lot for us all with better control around friend requests.

Please, make it possible. Because it's now very annoying problem and also not safe at all. There are weak people who just accept requests in VRChat, and before i know, we got crasher in our world thanks to Friends+ system (is really too powerful and chain link is very long). By default it must set on at least 1 week cooldown for everyone.
Sure it's no fun for some people to wait, but they can still ingame ask to others to add them as friend. We can still decide ingame. But not with many remote friend requests. That is very bad, and it showed the security of VRChat is not good enough. It's just too easy!
title: Friend Request system rework needed (security).
